captions.speaker: castle
captions.text: Nessa Venn. We ran ore together before she settled into the yards on Jangala.

captions.speaker: castle
captions.text: Once spent three days towing my dead freighter home and swore she'd cut me loose at every buoy. Never did.

captions.speaker: castle
captions.text: She'll have opinions about this ship. Let me talk first.
